confidence: Moderate overall; high for several close pairs (1/19, 11/12, 7/27, 8/10, 23/30), lower for allocating all thirty into exactly three equal groups. limitations: Viewed only the supplied numbered family.png. Fictional visual likeness grouping is subjective and does not establish biological kinship. Clothing is a substantial confound: apron portraits concentrate in C and fur-trimmed clothing helps distinguish the other apparent sets, so this result cannot demonstrate family recognition independently of costume. Forced ten-per-group constraint affects uncertain placements, especially 5, 9, 14, 22, 28 and 29. Shared painting style, pose, hair and near-duplicate face patterns can also inflate apparent relatedness. No keys, source portraits, expected labels or metadata were read.
